svg.aria-label: One screen pixel on a floor seen at a glancing angle covers a strip of texture 16 texels long and 1 texel wide. The mip level for 16 texels filters a square far wider than the strip, so it blurs across the strip as well as along it; the level for 1 texel reads one texel, sharp across but aliasing along the strip; anisotropic filtering spreads filtered samples along the strip's long axis.
